title: Book One · Chapter 40: The Wrong Sleeve
story:
Mum holds up a grey shirt and frowns.

Ronan is doing sums at the other end of the table. Mum is looking at the shirt, not his sums. Ronan puts his pencil down to listen.

“Wrong one,” Mum says.

She puts the grey shirt beside a white shirt. Both need sleeve work. Only one needs a shorter sleeve. Mum made the grey sleeve shorter.

“Can you make it long again?” Ronan asks.

“I left enough inside the fold. Yes. But it will take time.”

He looks at the labels. Both names are right. Each shirt has the right name. But Mum read the wrong job line.

“Was it my writing?”

“No,” she says. “I read the wrong note. This is my mistake.”

She gets a small tool from the sewing box. She lifts the first new stitch. Ronan watches one thread come free, then another. Mum made these stitches this afternoon. Now she takes each stitch out again.

The grey shirt's owner is due before dinner. There is not enough time for both shirts. She puts the tool down. Then she washes her hands. She takes her notebook to the door.

“We need to tell her now.”

Dad is out. Ronan cannot stay home alone. He goes with Mum. On the way, Mum buys no extra thread and stops at no other door. She goes straight to the grey shirt's owner.

The woman is annoyed. She needs it for work in the morning. “Can you finish it this evening?” the woman asks.

Mum checks the work in her notebook. “I can finish your grey shirt tonight. The white one will be ready tomorrow. I need to tell its owner now.”

Mum does not promise both shirts tonight. She checks the work and gives a clear time. The woman will collect her shirt later that evening. Mum will charge the first agreed price. The woman will not pay for Mum's mistake.

Back home, Ronan reaches for a thread. He wants to pull it from the sleeve to help. Mum asks him to clear a clean place first. Then he can put the right note there. She will use the sharp tools herself.

He clears the place. Then he returns to his sums. Mum still needs to sew. Ronan still has his own work to finish. He sits at the other end of the table.

Mum is still sewing. Dad comes home. He makes dinner. His tomato pieces are larger than Mum's pieces. Ronan says so.

“They'll be easier to find,” Dad says.

Mum laughs from the table. Her shoulders move down a little.

After dinner, Mum checks the sleeve length. She points to a place for the lamp. Dad holds it there. Ronan reads the owner's name from the label and the job from the notebook. They match.

The woman collects the shirt later that evening. She tries the sleeve and lifts her arms. The length is right. She pays the first agreed price, and Mum gives her the corrected note.

The gate closes behind the customer. “Will she come back?” Ronan asks.

“I don't know,” Mum says. “I corrected my mistake today. I cannot choose for her.”

She puts the white shirt's note in a separate place for tomorrow. Then she closes the sewing box. Ronan sees a tiny grey thread on her wrist. He takes it away gently. Mum looks at the thread in his fingers. She smiles and thanks him. Then she puts the sewing box away for the night.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：sleeve＝袖子；stitches＝针脚；mistake＝错误；length＝长度。

理解问题：

1. Mum 在哪件衣服上犯了错？
2. 她怎样处理错误和顾客的时间？
